extDescription.message: Automatically closes tabs you haven't looked at for a configurable number of hours. Pinned tabs are never touched.

optionsThresholdHelp.message: Whole hours between 1 and 720 (30 days). Default is 12.

optionsCheckIntervalHelp.message: Whole minutes between 1 and 60. Default is 10.

optionsWhitelistHelp.message: One hostname per line. "example.com" also matches every subdomain such as "app.example.com". Lines starting with # are ignored.

optionsExcludeGrouped.message: Never close tabs that belong to a tab group

optionsAlwaysExcluded.message: Pinned tabs, the active tab of each window, tabs playing audio, and the last tab in a window are always kept.
